notes.title: Poly Gangs Patch 0.0.3
notes.content:
Hi 
we are constantly working on making the game more efficient.

Below are the changes that are in the latest Patch:
1. Fixed sounds main menu keys.
2. Removed places slowing down walking in the DJ apartment.
3. Changing the DJ support respan.
4. Reworking the melee system (added the ability to aim fists - we hit the place where we are looking).
5. Repair of the radio (previously it did not turn on the first time we got into the car).
6. Getting rid of invisible blockers from the open world.
7. Improve the position of the rain.
8. Pause (ESC), pauses time in the game.

We hope that the gameplay is more and more enjoyable for you :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1480060/Poly_Gangs/

notes.title: Poly Gangs Patch 0.0.2
notes.content:
Patch 0.0.2, which includes:

1. Adding destroy system to cars
2. Repairing the dialogue with "Jelly Bean"
3. Improved loading of game settings (sensitivity fix, removal of the bug with resolution)
4. Improving the position of NPCs in the world (now they do not levitate and do not dig into the ground)
5. Optimize the game and improve the quality of Foliage on Enviro

Have a great game!

notes.title: PolyGangs Devlog #1
notes.content:
[h1]Yo dawg![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398706/35c865a8ca08d8d5076054959c869e77106a3a39.png[/img]

[h3]We haven`t written to you for a long time but from now on we'll regularly show the progress of our work on the game, our intention is to share with you 1-3 devlogs per month. 

Also, we would like to announce that we will be participating in the [b]Steam Next Fest: October 2022[/b]! Read our new devlog for more information.[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qTF6nAV.gif[/img]

[h2]MORE ABOUT POLY GANG[/h2]
Poly Gangs is a sandbox world action game in which we play the role of a young boy from the blocks. We discover its history during the game. The player can count on a lot of humorous actions, choices in the game (Different endings of the game, depending on the path of development chosen by the player), and a lot of fun - he will be able to move around the city. The game world is full of places and situations with which we can interact.

In the upcoming devlogs, the main character will appear who will take over the devlog narrative! 

[h2]ROADMAP[/h2]
Soon, many events await us - check out our Roadmap for more information!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398706/43e0f5bdd36eb36ac0836d0bd61cc0bbbc7355dc.png[/img] 

At the turn of July and August, you will see a new trailer showing the effects of the last months of work on Poly Gangs.

[list]
[*] [b]A new Trailer and Kickstarter[/b] - Along with the trailer, we will launch a Kickstarter fundraiser, thanks to which you will be able to buy a game with interesting bonuses (we are preparing a few surprises for you) and you will really help us create an even more interesting game for you!
[*] [b]October 2022[/b] - You will be able to check out our game for yourself at the [b]Steam Next Fest![/b] We are already looking forward to your comments - they will be invaluable to us because, in the end, we create the game for you. :)
[*] [b]Q1 2023[/b] - We will ask you for help in playtests - then there will also be an opportunity to discover our game.
[*] [b]Q2 2023[/b] - You will learn the whole story that we are writing for you and we hope that you will enjoy playing [b]Poly Gangs[/b].
[/list]
[h3]We would like to invite you to the world with a good dose of humor, and street music. Enjoy the atmosphere and emotions of the good old days! Be prepared for the unexpected twists and collaboration, which will surprise no one player from both the younger and the slightly older generation! 

What famous buildings and cars would you like to see in the game? Send us your suggestions![/h3]

[previewyoutube=eGmgkxb6Z-8;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Be sure to follow our discord channel for more PolyVersum content!

Best Regards,
PolyGods Team
